finalText:
The build finishes with 0 errors now.

Two real bugs caused the failure, both from the same bundler bump:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, a field the new bundler no longer sends. The new shape uses `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — `isBackoffEnabled` treated any non-boolean flag as an error. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` the same as `false` (disabled).

The rest of the noisy output was deprecation warnings (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) and informational notes — not build failures, so I left those alone. Build now exits 0 with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
